
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">JSON 是机器之间交换数据的通用格式，Word 文档则是给人阅读的载体。两者之间的转换本质上不是“格式转换”，而是一次</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">结构映射</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：JSON 的键值对、数组、嵌套对象，需要被翻译成段落、表格、标题等人类可读的文档组件。本文分享使用免费库 Free Spire.Doc for Python 完成 JSON 转 Word 的实现思路与代码示例，适合学习、轻量自动化场景。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.Doc for Python 是一个独立的 Word 文档处理库，不需要安装 Microsoft Word 即可创建和编辑 DOCX 文件。免费版通过 pip 安装：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install Spire.Doc.Free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">需要提前了解免费版的容量边界：</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">单文档最多 500 个段落和 25 个表格</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，超出部分会被截断。对于日常的报告生成、API 数据快照、中小规模台账来说够用；如果单次输出会稳定超过这个量级，就需要在数据分片或换用其他方案之间做选择。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心层级关系是理解后续所有代码的基础：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">Document → Section → Paragraph → TextRange
                  ↘ Table → Row → Cell → Paragraph
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Document</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是文档根对象，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Section</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 承载页面级设置，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Paragraph</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是文本容器，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">TextRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是段落中一段连续文本的格式控制入口。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">映射原则：JSON 结构决定 Word 形态</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">同一个 JSON，可以渲染出完全不同的文档。先确定映射规则，再写代码，比边写边调更可控。常见的对应关系如下：</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; display: table; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.95em; text-align: left; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">JSON 结构</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Word 元素</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">典型场景</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">扁平对象的键值对</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">段落（</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">键：值</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">）</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">配置说明、个人卡片、API 快照</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对象数组</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">表格（键→列标题，对象→行）</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">员工列表、订单、库存</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">嵌套对象</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">标题 + 缩进段落（递归）</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">结构化报告、层级摘要</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">图片路径字段</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">内联图片</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Logo、头像、图表快照</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">下面的代码按“扁平 → 数组 → 嵌套”的顺序递进，每个场景给出可直接运行的片段。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景一：扁平对象 → 键值段落</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这是最简单的映射：每个键值对生成一个段落。适合结构固定、字段不多的数据。</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> json
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> Document, FileFormat, HorizontalAlignment
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>json_str = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">'{"项目": "数据管道", "负责人": "张伟", "状态": "进行中", "启动日期": "2025-03-01"}'</span><br>
data = json.loads(json_str)</p>
<p>doc = Document()<br>
section = doc.AddSection()</p>
<p>title = section.AddParagraph()<br>
title.AppendText(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"项目信息"</span>).CharacterFormat.Bold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
title.Format.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> key, value <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> data.items():<br>
para = section.AddParagraph()<br>
para.AppendText(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{key}</span>：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{value}</span>"</span>).CharacterFormat.FontSize = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">12</span><br>
para.Format.AfterSpacing = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">6</span></p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">doc.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"flat_object.docx"</span>, FileFormat.Docx)<br>
doc.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AppendText</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 返回的是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">TextRange</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象，字体、字号、加粗等字符级格式都通过它来设置；段落级间距和对齐则通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">paragraph.Format</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。这套格式控制方式，在后续的表格单元格里同样适用。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景二：对象数组 → Word 表格</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对象数组对应表格的一行，列标题从记录中提取。但不要假设所有记录键完全一致——真实 API 返回的可选字段经常缺失，直接用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">record[key]</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 会让整批转换因为一条记录而中断。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">更稳健的做法是先扫描全部记录，收集键的并集作为列标题：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> json
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> (
    Document, FileFormat, HorizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment,
    TableRowHeightType, Color
)
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p>records = [<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"产品"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"笔记本电脑"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"单价"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">6999</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"库存"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">45</span>},<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"产品"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"无线鼠标"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"单价"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">199</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"库存"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">200</span>},<br>
{<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"产品"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"机械键盘"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"单价"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">549</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"库存"</span>: <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">120</span>},<br>
]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 动态收集列标题，兼容键不完全一致的记录</span><br>
all_keys = []<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> record <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> records:<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> key <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> record:<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> key <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">not</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> all_keys:<br>
all_keys.append(key)</p>
<p>doc = Document()<br>
section = doc.AddSection()</p>
<p>table = section.AddTable(<span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span>)<br>
table.ResetCells(<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(records) + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">len</span>(all_keys))</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 表头</span><br>
header_row = table.Rows[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]<br>
header_row.IsHeader = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
header_row.Height = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">24</span><br>
header_row.HeightType = TableRowHeightType.Exactly</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col, key <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(all_keys):<br>
cell = header_row.Cells[col]<br>
cell.CellFormat.BackColor = Color.get_Gray()<br>
cell.CellFormat.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Middle<br>
p = cell.AddParagraph()<br>
p.Format.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center<br>
tr = p.AppendText(key)<br>
tr.CharacterFormat.Bold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
tr.CharacterFormat.FontSize = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">11</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 数据行</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> row_idx, record <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(records, start=<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>):<br>
row = table.Rows[row_idx]<br>
row.Height = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">22</span><br>
row.HeightType = TableRowHeightType.Exactly<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> col, key <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(all_keys):<br>
cell = row.Cells[col]<br>
cell.CellFormat.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Middle<br>
p = cell.AddParagraph()<br>
p.Format.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center<br>
p.AppendText(<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">str</span>(record.get(key, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"—"</span>)))</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">doc.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"array_table.docx"</span>, FileFormat.Docx)<br>
doc.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">两个关键点：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ResetCells</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的行数是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">len(records) + 1</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，不是 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">len(records)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。表头也占一行。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">record.get(key, "—")</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 而不是下标访问。占位符保持列数统一，也避免单条记录缺字段导致整个脚本崩溃。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">场景三：嵌套对象 → 递归标题结构</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">嵌套 JSON 表达的是层级关系，不能塞进二维表格。用递归遍历，用一个 level 参数控制缩进和字号，形成视觉层次：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> Document, FileFormat
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">add_nested</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">section, obj, level=<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span></span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(obj, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">dict</span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> key, value <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> obj.items():<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(value, (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">dict</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list</span>)):<br>
heading = section.AddParagraph()<br>
tr = heading.AppendText(<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">str</span>(key))<br>
tr.CharacterFormat.Bold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
tr.CharacterFormat.FontSize = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">max</span>(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">14</span> - level * <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">10</span>)<br>
heading.Format.SetLeftIndent(level * <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">18</span>)<br>
add_nested(section, value, level + <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>)<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">else</span>:<br>
para = section.AddParagraph()<br>
para.Format.SetLeftIndent(level * <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">18</span>)<br>
tr = para.AppendText(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{key}</span>：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{value}</span>"</span>)<br>
tr.CharacterFormat.FontSize = <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">max</span>(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">12</span> - level, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">10</span>)<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">elif</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">isinstance</span>(obj, <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">list</span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> item <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> obj:<br>
add_nested(section, item, level)</p>
<p>nested = {<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"报告"</span>: {<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"标题"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"季度运营摘要"</span>,<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"周期"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"2025 Q2"</span>,<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"指标"</span>: {<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"营收"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"580万"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"同比"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"+12%"</span>},<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"备注"</span>: <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"所有区域均实现正增长"</span><br>
}<br>
}</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">doc = Document()<br>
section = doc.AddSection()<br>
add_nested(section, nested)<br>
doc.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"nested_report.docx"</span>, FileFormat.Docx)<br>
doc.Close()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">递归方法的好处是对深度不敏感——无论嵌套两层还是五层，逻辑不变。需要注意免费版的 500 段落上限：深层嵌套或超大数据集会快速消耗段落配额，在生产中应当根据实际输出规模做预判。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">补充：JSON 中的图片字段</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果 JSON 里包含图片路径（如 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">"logo": "images/logo.png"</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">），可以在对应位置用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AppendPicture</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 插入，并通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Width</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> / </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Height</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 控制显示尺寸（单位是磅）：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.doc <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> Paragraph
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">para = section.AddParagraph()<br>
pic = para.AppendPicture(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"images/logo.png"</span>)<br>
pic.Width = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">80</span><br>
pic.Height = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">50</span><br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果图片出现在表格单元格中，把 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AppendPicture</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 挂在 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">cell.AddParagraph()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 返回的段落上即可，与普通文本段落的使用方式一致。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">结语</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">从 JSON 到 Word 的核心不在于库本身，而在于</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">先想清楚数据的哪一层结构应该对应文档的哪一种元素</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：键值对用段落，记录集合用表格，层级关系用递归标题。映射规则确定之后，Free Spire.Doc 提供的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Document → Section → Paragraph / Table</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对象模型足够直接地把规则落到 DOCX 文件里。</span></p></section>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>

            </div>
